turns.text: Lloyd, did you see that new paper on Gaussian Splatting for robotics? I'm trying to wrap my head around SAFER-Splat.
I haven't reviewed the full text yet, but I know it focuses on safety constraints for navigation. What aspect are you interested in?
Mainly the failure modes. I read through the discussion section and noticed that SAFER-Splat's safety guarantees degrade when the Gaussian map is incomplete, such as in unknown environments.
That makes sense. Incomplete maps mean the model lacks confidence in those regions, so conservative safety margins might fail or become overly restrictive.
Yeah, exactly. Anyway, off-topic, my coffee maker just started leaking again. Do you know if that means I need a new gasket or just a clean?
Usually it's just mineral buildup or a worn gasket. Try a vinegar cycle first. If it persists, you might need to replace the seal.
Got it. I'll try the vinegar thing. Also, did you get the weather report for tomorrow? I'm planning to run in the park.
It looks like rain is expected around 4 PM, so an early morning run would be best.
